purpose: Versioned extension of the single Stödassistenten demand/friction regression map. This mapping stores product-learning memory only; it does not prove eligibility or factual truth.

mappings.product_miss: The public dental path is generic, so a person turning 67+ in 2026 can interpret 'tiotandvård' as 10 percent of the whole clinic invoice instead of a strengthened rule tied to specific measures and reference prices.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Require age/year, planned measure and reference-price disambiguation before cost claims; explicitly keep examinations, X-rays and preventive care outside the blanket 10-percent assumption and preserve the ordinary high-cost route for other measures.
